title: Replace hardcoded English fallback strings in TutoredChildrenSection's error snackbars

evidence.quote:
AppLocalizations.of(context)?.tutoredEntryPermissionDenied ??
    'Access denied — the grant may have been revoked.',

AppLocalizations.of(context)?.tutoredEntryError ??
    'Could not load talmid data. Please try again.',

why: Both snackbar messages fall back to raw, un-ARB'd English literals if AppLocalizations.of(context) returns null. That fallback would render untranslated on a Hebrew device in the (defensive-only) case it triggers. The same idiom exists at text_display_screen.dart:900 outside this batch, so it's a small but repeated pattern, not a one-off typo.
recommendation: Drop the ?? fallback (AppLocalizations.of(context) is non-null under the app's own MaterialApp) or route the fallback through a second ARB key instead of an inline literal.
acceptance_criteria: The hardcoded-string audit grep is extended to catch this null-coalescing idiom
